Title: Ishaan's Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Nitin - 41 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Sunita and Nitin stand near him.]

Sunita: "What's the plan today?"

[A light drizzle begins.]

Ishaan (gently): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Nitin (laughing): "Well done!"

[Snow begins to fall.]

Sunita: "Exactly right."

[Hailstones start falling.]

Sunita: "What happened?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Sunita: "So, here we are!"

[Ishaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Ishaan: "Okay, Mom."

[Ishaan drinks a glass of water.]

Ishaan (happily): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ishaan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Ishaan: "One more time!"

[Ishaan sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Ishaan (surprised): "Let's see."

[Ishaan types on his laptop.]

Ishaan (excited): "How beautiful!"

[Ishaan sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Ishaan: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ishaan opens the door and goes out.]

Ishaan: "I really enjoyed today."
